baselineComparison.instructions: Use the same setup and call against baseline and candidate. baselineAssertions are common numeric/state rules; candidate assertions add only selected non-explicit literal expectations.
baselineComparison.reason: hum_num remains a normal random draw. Assert populated bounds and exact deterministic list positions without fixing random selection or changing RNG calls.

listCases: early item plus two late items
coverage.egoText2Limit: ego<1 is appended after flaw_num is selected. Its hum_text2 value is written at index2 in these states, but the active flaw_num consumer keeps index1; no claim that it is selected by that consumer.

limits: These are diagnostic case definitions only. No engine run is claimed.
Root provides initial prime and refresh_database; case setups then isolate adult numeric states.
Whole actor-array equality is not asserted because existing #var_base regenerates ero_rwd_cnt. Selected condition inputs and money/date values are checked unchanged.
No LOCAL, function definition, random assignment/seed control, or game-file write.
